title: Save as otherwise expressly provided under this Act or by any other law for the time being in force

content.scenario: A consumer files a complaint with the State Commission, which then passes an order in appeal. The consumer wants to appeal to the National Commission, but the National Commission must be satisfied that the case involves a substantial question of law.
content.outcome: The National Commission will hear the appeal if it is satisfied that the case involves a substantial question of law.

user_queries: What is the process for appealing to the National Commission?
Can a consumer appeal to the National Commission if the State Commission has passed an order in appeal?
What are the requirements for the National Commission to hear an appeal?
